jsonld.name: LenaG inc Photography
jsonld.description: Photography studio in Miramar, FL specialized in newborn sessions and fine art portraits (including quinceañera and sweet 16 sessions), in studio and on location, by appointment only, with over 20 years of experience.

eyebrow.en: Miramar, FL · Newborn & Fine Art Photography

parrafo.es: LenaG inc Photography es el estudio de Lena en Miramar, con más de 20 años fotografiando recién nacidos y creando retratos de arte fino, en estudio o en locación. Trabaja solo con cita, dedicando el tiempo que cada sesión necesita.
parrafo.en: LenaG inc Photography is Lena's studio in Miramar, with more than 20 years photographing newborns and creating fine art portraits, in studio or on location. She works strictly by appointment, giving every session the time it needs.

hero.imagen_alt: Fine art quinceañera portrait session by LenaG inc Photography on a garden staircase

parrafo_1.es: Lena lleva más de 20 años fotografiando en Miramar, especializada en sesiones de recién nacidos y retratos de arte fino. En muchas sesiones de bebés la acompaña su hija, y juntas se toman el tiempo que cada familia necesita.
parrafo_1.en: Lena has spent more than 20 years photographing in Miramar, specializing in newborn sessions and fine art portraits. For many newborn sessions her daughter works alongside her, and together they take the time each family needs.

parrafo_2.es: Su estudio es luminoso y ordenado, con props y telas propias para cada sesión. Las familias describen su manera de trabajar como paciente, profesional y única, sobre todo con bebés y niños pequeños.
parrafo_2.en: Her studio is bright and clean, stocked with her own props and wraps for every session. Families describe the way she works as patient, professional and unique, especially with babies and toddlers.

nosotros.imagen_1_alt: Newborn baby asleep on a mini prop bed during a LenaG inc Photography session
nosotros.imagen_2_alt: Newborn wrapped in a caramel wrap, LenaG inc Photography studio session

texto.es: Cuéntale a Lena qué tipo de sesión buscas (recién nacido, arte fino, quince) al (786) 367-3706. Trabaja solo con cita, sin formularios ni intermediarios.
texto.en: Tell Lena what kind of session you want (newborn, fine art, quinceañera) at (786) 367-3706. She works strictly by appointment, no forms, no middlemen.

texto.es: Revisan juntas la fecha, el vestuario, los props y si la sesión es en el estudio o en locación.
texto.en: You go over the date, wardrobe, props and whether the session happens in studio or on location.

texto.es: Con bebés, todo al ritmo del pequeño, con paciencia y props propios. Con retratos de arte fino, la locación y la luz hacen el resto.
texto.en: With babies, everything moves at the baby's pace, with patience and her own props. With fine art portraits, the location and the light do the rest.

texto.es: Recibes tus fotos editadas, listas para guardar y compartir con la familia.
texto.en: You receive your edited photos, ready to keep and share with family.

nota.es: Cada sesión se cotiza según el tipo de sesión y la locación. Llama y te damos el detalle, sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every session is quoted based on the type of shoot and the location. Call and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Gemelos, bebés únicos y hermanos, fotografiados con paciencia y los props y telas propios del estudio. Las familias la describen como calmada, profesional y muy buena con los bebés.
texto.en: Twins, single babies and siblings, photographed with patience using the studio's own wraps and props. Families describe her as calm, professional and great with babies.

texto.es: Sesiones de retrato dramáticas en locación, desde escaleras de jardín hasta cenotes, pensadas para una fecha que se celebra una sola vez.
texto.en: Dramatic on-location portrait sessions, from garden staircases to hidden cenotes, built for a date that only happens once.

titulo.es: Sesiones de bebés y niños pequeños

texto.es: Sesiones pacientes y a su ritmo para bebés que ya pasaron la etapa de recién nacido y para niños pequeños, con props para cada edad.
texto.en: Patient, unhurried sessions for babies past the newborn stage and for toddlers, with props kept on hand for every age.

texto.es: En estudio o en locación, Lena lleva más de dos décadas armando sesiones de retrato a medida, siempre solo con cita.
texto.en: In studio or on location, Lena has spent more than two decades building custom portrait sessions, always by appointment only.

pie.es: ¿No ves lo que buscas? Llama igual: Lena lleva más de 20 años haciendo esto.
pie.en: Do not see what you are looking for? Call anyway: Lena has been doing this for over 20 years.

items.quote: Had such an incredible experience with Lena & her wonderful daughter! My husband and I booked her to shoot our newborn twin daughters. She was so knowledgeable in photography, poised, professional and really great with the babies.

Lena is an amazing photographer. She was so patient with my toddler during my daughter's newborn shoot. Her studio is bright, clean and she has lots of different props and unique ideas. I highly recommend her for all your photography needs. She is awesome!

I highly recommend Lena G Inc Photography, she's very personal, professional and unique. She walks you through every step of the way and takes her time to take your pictures. I recently did my newborn session for my twin girls.
